title: The Model Wars Heat Up
overview: March 2026 proved to be one of the densest months in AI history, with four frontier model releases compressed into a single 23-day window: GPT-5.4 (three variants), Gemini 3.1 Ultra, Grok 4.20, and Mistral Small 4. Agentic infrastructure hit a mainstream milestone as Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) crossed 97 million installs, signaling the protocol's permanent place in how AI agents are built. Enterprise adoption accelerated—67% of Fortune 500 marketing budgets now include dedicated AI line items—while regulatory pressure intensified with the EU AI Act issuing its first formal inquiries and three US states passing AI transparency laws.
